notes: Twenty source and twenty-eight target tokens partitioned exactly once.

חַי is read as the oath predicate carrying both *As* and *liveth*, the unit discontinuous around the divine name under rule 25; the competing readings would put *liveth* on יהוה or mark *As* a supplied subordinator under rule 55, and neither is preferable since the whole formula is what חַי is rendered by.
The Hithpael reflexive *themselves* stays with הִתְבָּרְכוּ under rule 44's voice rider.
